vote.question: On the Joint Resolution
vote.senate_document_text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to "Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program Record of Decision".

object.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program Record of Decision.

cra.rule_title: Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program Record of Decision
cra.consequence_ref: Congressional Review Act, 5 U.S.C. 801(b): a rule disapproved by an enacted joint resolution shall not take effect (or shall not continue in effect) and may not be reissued in substantially the same form without subsequent statutory authorization.
